description: GitHub Dark Default: the near-black canvas and blue accent of GitHub.com, from the official GitHub VS Code Theme.
One Dark Pro: Atom's One Dark, grey-blue with a blue accent.
Dracula: the dark theme with purple, pink and green highlights.
Material Theme: Google Material's blue grey with a teal accent, by Mattia Astorino.
Ayu Dark: a near-black background with warm yellow accents.
Ayu Mirage: the muted blue-grey middle variant of ayu.
Ayu Light: a bright, soft light theme with an orange accent.
Classic Monokai as Visual Studio Code ships it, under the MIT License. This is not Monokai Pro.
Night Owl: deep blue for working at night and in low light, by Sarah Drasner.
One Monokai: One Dark's background with Monokai's colours.
Tokyo Night: dark blue with soft neon colours, after Tokyo's lights at night.
Solarized Dark: Ethan Schoonover's sixteen-colour palette on dark blue-green.
Solarized Light: Ethan Schoonover's sixteen-colour palette on warm cream.
Winter is Coming (Dark Blue): dark blue with icy blue accents, by John Papa.
Gruvbox Dark: retro, warm browns and earthy colours.
Gruvbox Light: the retro, warm gruvbox palette on cream.
Shades of Purple: bold purple with a bright yellow accent, by Ahmad Awais.
Cobalt2: deep blue with a yellow accent, by Wes Bos.
Noctis: a cold, dark teal theme.
Noctis Lux: the warm, cream light variant of Noctis.
Catppuccin Frappé: the soothing pastel palette, muted dark flavour.
Catppuccin Macchiato: the soothing pastel palette, medium dark flavour.
Panda: a superminimal dark theme with pink, blue and mint, by Siamak Mokhtari.
SynthWave '84: retrowave neon pink and cyan on dark purple, by Robb Owen.
Atom One Light: Atom's clean light theme, as Mahmoud Ali ported it to VS Code.
Darcula: the colours of JetBrains' dark theme, from an MIT community port.
Sublime Material: Material Theme's syntax colours on a neutral dark grey, from the Sublime Material Theme port.
Palenight: Material's pale purple night variant, by Olaolu Olawuyi.
Omni: a dark theme with purple, pink and green, by Rocketseat.
Snazzy Light: a bright light theme after Hyper Snazzy, by Florian Reuschel.
Matcha: a dark, earthy theme of green and grey, by Luca Falasco.
Houston: the Astro team's dark theme with mint and cyan accents.
Horizon Dark: a warm sunset of pink and apricot on dark blue-grey.
Horizon Bright: the warm sunset palette on pale peach.
Everforest Dark: a green-based palette, warm and soft to protect the eyes (medium contrast).
Everforest Light: the same warm, soft green palette on cream (medium contrast).
Kanagawa Wave: a dark scheme inspired by the colours of Hokusai's famous painting.
Rosé Pine: all natural pine, faux fur and a bit of soho vibes for the classy minimalist.
Rosé Pine Dawn: the light variant of Rosé Pine, warm cream with dusky rose.
